articles.title_en: Central Banks as Dollar Lenders of Last Resort: Implications for Regulation and Reserve Holdings
articles.title_cn: 中央银行作为最后贷款人的美元贷方：对监管和储备持有的影响
articles.abstract_en: We explore how foreign central banks behave when firms engage in currency mismatch, borrowing heavily in dollars. A central bank can deal with risky private-sector mismatch in two ways: (i) with financial regulation or (ii) by accumulating reserves to better serve as a dollar lender of last resort. We highlight a novel externality:Individual central banks may over accumulate dollar reserves, as this exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated assets, lowering dollar interest rates and encouraging firms to further increase their currency mismatch. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer tighter financial regulation and reduced holdings of dollar reserves.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了当企业在美元中大量借款时，外国中央银行的行为。中央银行可以通过两种方式应对私营部门的风险性错配：(i) 通过金融监管，或 (ii) 通过积累储备以更好地作为最后贷款人的美元贷方。我们强调了一种新颖的外部性：各个中央银行可能会过度积累美元储备，因为这加剧了美元计价资产的全球稀缺，降低美元利率，并鼓励企业进一步增加其货币错配。相较于分散的结果，全球规划者可能更倾向于更严格的金融监管和减少美元储备的持有。

articles.title_en: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
articles.title_cn: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响
articles.abstract_en: Using county-level and zip-code-level data from the United States during the period 1998–2018, we document: (i) Increased flood risk has a large negative impact on firm entry, employment, and output in the long run; (ii) Flood events reduce output in the short run while impact on firm entry and employment is limited. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to characterize how flood risk shapes firms' location choices and employment. We find flood risk reduced US aggregate output by 0.53 percent in 2018, 23 percent of which stemmed from direct damages and 77 percent from long-run adjustments of firms and workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用美国在1998-2018期间的县级和邮政编码级数据，我们记录到：（i）增加的洪水风险对企业进入、就业和长期产出产生了较大的负面影响；（ii）洪水事件在短期内减少了产出，而对企业进入和就业的影响有限。然后，我们开发了一个定量空间模型，以描述洪水风险如何影响企业的选址选择和就业。我们发现洪水风险在0.53%减少了美国的总体产出2018，其中23%来自直接损失，77%来自企业和工人的长期调整。

articles.title_en: Import Liberalization as Export Destruction? Evidence from the United States
articles.title_cn: 进口自由化是否导致出口破坏？来自美国的证据
articles.abstract_en: In trade models with scale economies, import liberalization reduces exports within industries by shrinking real market potential. We find this export destruction mechanism reduced US export growth following the permanent normalization of trade relations with China (PNTR). There was also an offsetting boost to exports from lower input costs. We use our estimates to calibrate a quantitative model and show that scale economies are economically important for trade policy analysis. Although PNTR increased aggregate US exports relative to GDP, exports declined in the most exposed industries. US gains from PNTR are positive but 30 percent smaller than under constant returns.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有规模经济的贸易模型中，进口自由化通过缩小实际市场潜力来减少行业内的出口。我们发现这一出口破坏机制在与中国的永久正常化贸易关系（PNTR）后减少了美国的出口增长。同时，较低的输入成本也对出口产生了抵消的推动作用。我们使用我们的估计来校准一个定量模型，并表明规模经济在贸易政策分析中具有经济重要性。尽管PNTR相对于GDP增加了美国的整体出口，但在最受影响的行业中，出口却出现了下降。美国从PNTR中获得的收益是正的，但30%小于在恒定收益下的收益。

articles.title_en: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
articles.title_cn: 美国真的摆脱了二战债务吗？
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在1951之前，主要预算盈余、意外通胀和固定利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。我们发现，如果没有意外通胀和协议前的固定利率造成的实际利率扭曲，主要预算平衡下，债务/GDP比率仅会从106%在1946下降到74%在1974，而不是像实际历史中那样下降到23%。我们的研究结果表明，在过去的76年中，仅通过超过未扭曲利率的增长率实现了少量的债务减少。

articles.title_en: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
articles.title_cn: 流行病中的行为与政策分析模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在可处理的均衡环境中，易感于致命疾病的个体行为。我们从分析上刻画了个体最优的减缓行为及其导致的均衡轨迹。分析通过相图得以简化。一个关键的见解是，易感于疾病的个体最优行为导致了过度谨慎。这种行为扁平化了流行病曲线并延长了流行病的持续时间。相反，社会最优行为导致了更高的感染率，重点在于以最低成本最小化累计死亡人数。本文提供了新的技术贡献，并改善了对经济流行病模型中外部性的理解。

articles.title_en: The Economic Consequences of Effective Carbon Taxes
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the sectoral and macroeconomic consequences of carbon taxes in four Nordic countries using a novel monthly measure of effective carbon tax rates. The suggested measure accounts for the time-varying emission coverage of taxes that are both explicitly and implicitly levied on greenhouse gas-emitting goods, thereby solving several issues of existing carbon tax measures currently used by the literature. Employing the new measure in a local projection setting, I find that carbon taxes reduce emissions as expected but also impair macroeconomic activity—though there is some heterogeneity in the effects across sectors and countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了四北欧国家碳税的部门和宏观经济后果，使用了一种新颖的有效碳税率的月度测量方法。所建议的测量方法考虑了对温室气体排放商品征收的税收的时间变化覆盖范围，包括显性和隐性征收，从而解决了当前文献中使用的现有碳税测量方法的几个问题。在局部投影设置中使用新测量方法，我发现碳税如预期那样减少排放，但也损害了宏观经济活动——尽管不同部门和国家之间的影响存在一定的异质性。

articles.title_en: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
articles.title_cn: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响
articles.abstract_en: Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers' job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age.
articles.abstract_cn: 就业保护往往导致二分层劳动市场，造成工作安全性存在显著差异。我使用定量生命周期模型估计取消这些保护的影响，其中年轻工人更可能选择不稳定的工作。工人在就业时积累人力资本，并在失业时面临人力资本损失的可能性。由于拥有更高工作安全性的工人经历的失业期较少，他们在职业生涯中往往积累更多的人力资本。我表明，减少就业保护提高了年轻工人的求职成功率，但降低了人力资本、GDP和就业。这些政策的影响在不同年龄段之间存在显著差异。

articles.title_en: University Research and the Market for Higher Education
articles.title_cn: 大学研究与高等教育市场
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a framework in which university research depends endogenously on competition for tuition and talented students in the market for higher education. When students are highly stratified across colleges, or when tuition rises sharply with school rank, universities spend on R&D even if the direct contribution of research to teaching is small. The model is consistent with causal evidence and matches new features of the microdata. It explains why universities internally fund research with tuition, despite negligible returns to patenting. Calibrated simulations suggest that existing tuition policies boost university research while research subsidies crowd it out.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个框架，其中大学研究内生地依赖于高等教育市场中对学费和优秀学生的竞争。当学生在各个学院之间高度分层，或者当学费随着学校排名急剧上升时，大学即使在研究对教学的直接贡献较小的情况下也会在研发上投入。该模型与因果证据一致，并与微观数据的新特征相匹配。它解释了为什么大学用学费内部资助研究，尽管专利的回报微乎其微。标定的模拟表明，现有的学费政策促进了大学研究，而研究补贴则挤出了研究。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the dispersion and cyclicality of TFPR. Recent business cycle models assume countercyclical dispersion in TFPQ based on evidence of countercyclical dispersion in TFPR, though TFPR reflects endogenous prices. An overlapping generations model with monopolistic competition and state-dependent pricing is constructed to match three key data patterns: (i) countercyclical dispersion of TFPR, (ii) countercyclical dispersion of price changes, and (iii) countercyclical frequency of price adjustment. These patterns are matched either if shocks to the dispersion of TFPQ are negatively correlated with the mean of TFPQ, or if the monetary authority responds to them by "leaning against the wind."
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了TFPR的分散性和周期性。最近的商业周期模型假设TFPQ的分散性是反周期的，这基于TFPR中反周期分散性的证据，尽管TFPR反映了内生价格。构建了一个具有垄断竞争和状态依赖定价的重叠世代模型，以匹配三的关键数据模式：（i）TFPR的反周期分散性，（ii）价格变化的反周期分散性，以及（iii）价格调整的反周期频率。这些模式的匹配要么是TFPQ的分散性冲击与TFPQ的均值呈负相关，要么是货币当局通过“逆风而行”来应对这些冲击。

articles.title_en: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies in the Transition to Clean Technology
articles.title_cn: 向清洁技术过渡中的自我实现预言
articles.abstract_en: Technological lock-in has been a standard explanation for the slow take-off of clean innovation, but is hard to reconcile with forward-looking investors who anticipate the eventual switch to clean technologies. We provide an alternative explanation: strategic investment complementarities shape innovation and self-fulfilling prophecies can lead to delayed low-carbon transition. We analyze a standard directed technical change model with clean and dirty inputs. Under good input substitutability, two stable steady states co-exist, each allowing multiple transitional paths. Optimal low-carbon transition requires a Pigouvian tax rule combined with a coordination device; commitment to a Pigouvian tax trajectory cannot solve a coordination failure.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术锁定一直是清洁创新缓慢起步的标准解释，但与预期最终转向清洁技术的前瞻性投资者难以调和。我们提供了一种替代解释：战略投资互补性塑造创新，自我实现的预言可能导致低碳转型的延迟。我们分析了一个标准的定向技术变革模型，包含清洁和污染输入。在良好的输入可替代性下，二 稳定的稳态共存，每个稳态允许多条过渡路径。最优的低碳转型需要结合协调机制的庇古税规则；对庇古税轨迹的承诺无法解决协调失败。

articles.title_en: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
articles.title_cn: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病
articles.abstract_en: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果具有异质技能的工人自我选择进入不同部门，服务部门的劳动生产率增长可能被误测。我用美国数据记录到，从制造业重新分配的工人比专业服务的在职工人赚得更多，但比教育、健康和公共服务的在职工人赚得更少。一个广义的定量罗伊模型预测，专业服务的劳动生产率增长的选择效应比传统选择模型预测的高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业的成本病贡献不大，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。

articles.title_en: Deciphering Federal Reserve Communication via Text Analysis of Alternative FOMC Statements
articles.title_cn: 通过对替代FOMC声明的文本分析解读美联储沟通
articles.abstract_en: We propose a text-based measure of monetary policy stance that models FOMC statements as convex combinations of dovish and hawkish alternatives, providing a tractable representation of the Committee's position along the policy spectrum. Leveraging staff-drafted alternative statements, we fine-tune a pretrained language model to capture both quantitative precision and semantic tone. Stance is defined as the product of tone and novelty, and decomposed into expected and surprise components using high-frequency financial data. Surprises arise from shifts in tone relative to expectations or from statement novelty. Our framework enables counterfactuals showing how alternative communication could have moved markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于文本的货币政策立场度量，模型化FOMC声明为鸽派和鹰派替代方案的凸组合，提供了委员会在政策光谱上的位置的可处理表示。利用工作人员起草的替代声明，我们微调了一个预训练的语言模型，以捕捉定量精确性和语义语调。立场被定义为语调和新颖性的乘积，并使用高频金融数据分解为预期和意外成分。意外来自于相对于预期的语调变化或声明的新颖性。我们的框架能够进行反事实分析，展示替代沟通如何影响市场。

articles.title_en: Resource Misallocation in European Firms: The Role of Constraints, Firm Characteristics, and Managerial Decisions
articles.title_cn: 欧洲企业中的资源错配：约束、企业特征和管理决策的作用
articles.abstract_en: Using a new survey, we document high dispersion of marginal revenue products across firms in the European Union. To interpret this dispersion, we develop a highly portable framework to quantify gains from better allocation of resources. We demonstrate that apart from direct measures of distortions, firm characteristics, such as demographics, quality of inputs, utilization of resources, and dynamic adjustment of inputs, are predictors of the marginal revenue products of capital and labor. We emphasize that some firm characteristics may reflect compensating differentials rather than constraints and the effect of constraints on the dispersion of marginal products maybe smaller.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过一项新调查，我们记录了欧盟企业边际收益产品的高度分散。为了解释这种分散，我们开发了一个高度可移植的框架来量化更好资源配置的收益。我们证明，除了扭曲的直接测量，企业特征，如人口统计、投入质量、资源利用和投入的动态调整，是资本和劳动边际收益产品的预测因素。我们强调，一些企业特征可能反映补偿性差异而非约束，约束对边际产品分散的影响可能较小。
